heroImage.alt: hero image for a post about mindbending thriller books

children.text: For this list, we went looking for thrillers that give you very few reasons to trust your first impression.
Some will make you suspicious of the people at the center of the story.
Others will have you questioning whether you can trust the story itself.
And a few will let you
settle comfortably into a theory before giving you a very good reason to throw it out the window
Here are 17 thrillers to read when you’re in the mood to doubt everything.

metaDescription: From unreliable narrators to secrets that change everything, these reader-recommended thrillers reward a healthy amount of suspicion.
methodologySentence: To create this article, we analysed 2,181 reader recommendations. We pulled the 17 books on this list from a larger list of the top 50 most-recommended books.
title: These 17 Thrillers Will Have You Questioning Everything and Everyone
